pr_body: Fixes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/93794 ### Before All text is cut: ### After If possible, wrapped lines are aligned to the first wrapped line that is not all indent: Otherwise, it still should fill at least 40% of the width all the time (should it be a user adjustable value?):

issue_context.title: TextEdit: Text not shown with too many tabs and `indent_wrapped_lines`
issue_context.body:
### Tested versions

Godot v4.3.beta (4ab8fb809)

### System information

Windows 10.0.22631 - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 (NVIDIA; 31.0.15.5186) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10750H CPU @ 2.60GHz (12 Threads)

### Issue description

- related https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/88546
- I found this while looking into https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/93762

If you have `indent_wrapped_lines` enabled and a line after many tabs, it doesn't get wrapped anymore. It tries to put the text after the indentation to match the first line, but there is too much and the text can't be shown. 
It should reset the indent count if there is too many.

![image](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/assets/10054226/b2b86d9a-c7d8-4f4e-9ddf-0c854a1d1d83)



### Steps to reproduce

1. Make sure word wrap and `indent_wrapped_lines` is on.
2. Have a script with text after many tabs or spaces so it goes out of view, like `																														 	#test`

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A
